independent_observations.layout: A low-roof west ground workshop joins an enclosed east longhouse; work is distributed across the side shed and upper northwest workroom, with internal doors separating upper east apparatus room and south bed/storage room. This combined two-level work and internal three-direction room organization is one related whole reference, not a room/ladder/profession count.
independent_observations.proportion: Declared21x18x25, highest actual nonairy15; y16/17 contain no stored structure. Actual3083 unique records=2196nonair+887explicitair,6367omitted. Sparse omission never means cleared air. Four valid bed pairs and three unmatched south-facingfoot records, not11beds.
independent_observations.facade: Dark-oak frame and sandstone lower enclosure support pink-terracotta upper gables and white-wool internal partitions. Red glass panes are original; blue generic diagram color is not material evidence. One lower south door and two upper interior doors are three doors with paired halves.
independent_observations.roof: Low workshop cover and longhouse double slopes form one attached whole body. Original oak/spruce stairs/slabs/trapdoors model eaves; generic whole-cell gray diagrams neither actual stone roofing nor collision geometry. Two empty lit campfires are separate base/smoke details, not two proven production rooms.
independent_observations.materials: West stonecutter7,3,10 and campfire4,3,10 contrast upper damaged-anvil10,9,13 and east hopper15,9,8/brewing15,10,8. Fourteen barrels include11empty and3named potion-loot references; two boxes use own normal loot with nested vanillaweaponsmith. Original cauldronlevel3 retained without modern-water or lava reinterpretation.
independent_observations.circulation: East-facing ladder10,3..8,10 ends at explicitair10,9..11,10 beside wood landing11,8,10 and clear upperair. Upper west aisle x12,y9,z8..13 reaches east door13,9,8 or south door12,9,14; latter leads to bed/storage, former apparatus room. Ground west shed is separated by main-room wall, not an asserted indoor through-corridor. Headroom/doors/climbing/NPC pathfinding untested.
independent_observations.ground_relationship: Timber posts and granite/sandstone base support side shed and longhouse; east brick bottom stair pair x18/19 rises y0z12→y1z13→y2z14. Forestroot single rigid template, emptyprocessors/fallback and no originaljigsaw keep whole body local. No actual slope/placement/rain/fire/inhabitant route acceptance.

observations.layout: 北部x1..23/z1..9长热作业石厅，岩浆槽与铁砧、砂轮、锻造台并置；南/东接木框架主屋，主工作层y4、上居住层y10，顶下y15储藏空间。最低y0有小储藏/家具层，地表关系待验，不按每屋脊/烟囱计楼层。
observations.proportion: 声明26×25×23，但非空气实际x0..25/y0..21/z0..22（见精确extents）；6090保存位置=4142非空气+1948显式air，另8860省略，不能把省略当清空或强求每格存储。主屋高坡顶、低热作业厅和高烟囱相配，屋体不按组件拆数。
observations.facade: 去皮云杉梁柱把浅墙分格，窗、挑檐、外平台区分两层；西侧三格宽外踏步进入主层，石质热厅北侧封闭长墙配高烟囱。两屋体系在同一完整模板内，不是把独立房碎片拼数。
observations.roof: 主屋高山墙坡顶与低厅交接，灰色只是分类：原材质含red_terracotta187/pink_terracotta184、light_gray_wool161和云杉木构，不能称全灰石瓦；红陶土主要在上部。y20烟囱口一圈8个营火，中央口不等于实机通烟已验。
observations.materials: stone_bricks450/stone442/stripped_spruce_wood363/cobblestone227等；y4共24格lava源（以精确功能清单为准），热厅4个铁砧状态、砂轮(15,4,8)、锻造台(11,4,5)、空且未点燃高炉(18,4,3)。旧level3炼药锅在地下层，主厅锅(17,4,3)level0，不虚构现代水锅/淬火工作。
observations.circulation: 西外梯三格宽x7/y0→8/y1→9/y2→10/y3,z14..16，主层门(15,4,15)west。内折阶x18/y4→19/y5→20/y6,z15/16再转x21/22,z14/y7→13/y8→12/y9至y10；y10..14梯(19,y,8)north接y15顶下储藏。只证明原布局意图，转角净空、落脚、床开门和NPC通路均未验。
observations.terrain: root taiga tag/height0/WORLD_SURFACE_WG/beardthin，单元素rigid/emptyprocessor/emptyfallback，模板0jigsaw，不缺屋翼pool。最低门(7,0,11)下方不在模板，源稀疏省略不等于地形空气；不证明地下层自然掩埋、山脚地基或岩浆防火安全。
